contradictions.detail: The listing header says 'Price includes fees', while the dealer disclaimer says 'Plus government fees and taxes, any finance charges, any dealer document processing charge, any electronic filing charge, and any emission testing charge'. The out-the-door figure is ambiguous.

critical_evidence.evidence: No P2440/P2442 history or repair documented. CARFAX shows a 03/25/2026 Christian Brothers visit ('computer checked, engine checked, engine/powertrain module checked') at 110,153 with no stated finding, about three weeks before the dealer took title. The CA emissions pass on 05/07/2026 suggests no MIL then, but codes could have been cleared beforehand.

documentation.rationale: Identity and terms are solid: VIN, CARFAX-guaranteed clean title, two owners, odometer history, accident disclosed. Maintenance evidence is partial: 12 CARFAX service lines, mostly oil and brakes. There are no invoices and no photos of at-risk areas (underside, engine valley, right-front repair). Fluid, plug and cooling history are absent, and outcomes of the 03/2026 diagnostic and 2023 collision repair are undocumented.

condition.rationale: Photos show tidy paint and light interior wear (driver seat creasing, soiled carpet). Observed history items are a 2023 right-front sideswipe with no repair documentation and a pre-sale engine/computer diagnostic with no recorded result. Front brakes were serviced three times between 12/2023 and 02/2026, with a wheel-bearing service in 02/2026. Nothing proves good underside, cooling or driveline condition.

price_value.rationale: $22,940 sits essentially at the fair-value mid ($23,064) and within the band ($21,938–$29,128). Base trim plus a reported accident argue for no premium. Fee inclusion is ambiguous. CARFAX shows it offered since 05/2026, which may give negotiating room. No known-work items are established.

mission_fit.rationale: Body-on-frame V8 with full-time 4WD, low range, center-diff lock, roof rails and a hitch: real capability the RX 350 lacks, suiting a rooftop tent or sleeping platform. An automatic is fine for this branch, and the price is within the max-price band. Third-row seating adds little to the camping brief.

logistics.rationale: San Jose is roughly 75 miles from Carmel, an easy drive for a PPI and pickup. It is a California dealer with a passed CA smog in 05/2026. PPI permission is not stated but should be easy to arrange locally.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Base trim is the least desirable GX configuration (no Premium/Luxury features). The attractive burgundy over ivory and the stock, unmodified state are modest offsets.

evidence.mission_note: A stock, western-history GX 460 supplies true body-on-frame, low-range capability and roof-rail mounting for a rooftop tent, which the household RX 350 cannot. It fits the utility_capability branch rather than the enthusiast bridge brief. Accelerated-bridge mode allows moving promptly, but not skipping the PPI.
evidence.rationale: The CARFAX report establishes identity, a guaranteed clean title, two personal owners in California and Arizona, and an odometer trail matching the listed 110,251 miles. It also documents a minor 2023 sideswipe to the right front and front, with no repair record supplied. The service history is mostly oil and brake work at a dealer, then independent and chain shops. Front brakes were serviced three times between 12/2023 and 02/2026, alongside a wheel-bearing service. A 03/25/2026 engine/computer diagnostic with no stated finding came just before the dealer acquired the car, which is the main open question, especially for secondary air injection. A California smog pass at 110,243 in 05/2026 is partial reassurance on warning lights at that date. No reported entries exist for coolant, ATF, transfer-case or differential fluids, or spark plugs, and KDSS fitment, valley-plate leakage, tire dates and towing use are unexamined. Price sits at the fair-value midpoint, and the car is close to Carmel with PPI access likely but unconfirmed.
evidence.next_action: Call CARFORNIA to request the 03/25/2026 Christian Brothers diagnostic invoice, the 2023 collision repair record and an itemised out-the-door quote, then book an independent Toyota/Lexus PPI in San Jose with a full code scan and cold-start air-injection check before any deposit.
